concepts.def: A short, strong feeling with body signs
The words you have for things
Skill of noticing and using feelings

walkthroughs.body_html:
There are dozens of feelings beyond happy and sad:

  • Excited, proud, grateful.
  • Nervous, frustrated, jealous.
  • Embarrassed, awkward, content.

Naming helps you handle them. 📝

Anxiety is a worried, on-edge feeling.

Body signs: racing heart, butterflies, sweaty palms.

A little anxiety helps you prepare. A lot can hurt — talk to someone.

Emotional intelligence (EQ) is:

  • Noticing your feelings.
  • Noticing others'.
  • Using that to choose better actions.

People with high EQ make better friends and leaders. 🤝

numericals.q: If you can name 30 feelings rather than 5, how many extra?
